question:
The outer radius of a spherical shell is 9 cm and the thickness of the shell is 1 cm. Find the volume of the metal used for the shell (in cubic cm).

( {{{Use}} {{pi }} = frac{{22}}{7}} )
solution:
Given:

The outer radius of a spherical shell is 9 cm and the thickness of the shell is 1 cm. 

Concept used:

Volume of a sphere = {4 over 3} times pi times (Radius³)

Calculation:

Hence, the radius of the inner part = 9 - 1 = 8 cm

The volume of the metal used for the shell should equal the difference between the volume of the outer and inner parts.

Thus, The volume of the metal used for the shell

⇒ {4 over 3} times pi times (9³ - 8³)

⇒ ​​909(1)/(3) cm³

**∴ The volume of the metal used for the shell is 909(1)/(3) cm3.**
